name: Build Linux Systemlibs

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [basic, hardsubx]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git pkg-config \
            libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev \
            libswresample-dev libavfilter-dev libavdevice-dev

      - name: Build ${{ matrix.variant }}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" = "basic" ]; then
            make -system-libs -j$(nproc)
          else
            make -system-libs -hardsubx -j$(nproc)
          fi

      - name: Verify dynamic linking
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.variant }}" = "basic" ]; then
            echo "Basic variant ldd:"
            ldd ccextractor
          else
            echo "HardSubX variant ldd:"
            ldd ccextractor-hardsubx
          fi

      - name: Upload basic artifact
        if: matrix.variant == 'basic'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-basic
          path: ccextractor

      - name: Upload hardsubx artifact
        if: matrix.variant == 'hardsubx'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-hardsubx
          path: ccextractor-hardsubx
